meta.purpose: real batch-1 latency+energy for IV3-38B (removes the router's amortized-batch-latency proxy caveat for the 38B peer strong leg)

setup.engine: vLLM tp=2 (both A100-80GB), batch-1 (max_num_seqs=1, one request at a time), real VQA-RAD images (max_side=896), NVML energy summed over both GPUs via run_peer_eval --batch1

verdict: IV3-38B measured batch-1: no-think 1409 ms / 598 J (gen_tok 2.0), think 6220 ms / 3276 J (gen_tok 173.2). Think is ~4.4x slower and ~5.5x more energy at batch-1. These are MEASURED (not amortized-batch) numbers for the 38B peer strong leg.
